reuse.why: Defines the rule once in a guard helper and calls it from every provider link function; it does not fold the check into the existing shared linkBankSyncAccount, which would have needed the bank lookup moved inside it.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; only five one-line guard calls repeat the provider literal that each function also passes to linkBankSyncAccount.

placement.why: The tree already funnels all linking through linkBankSyncAccount, yet the precondition sits in each provider wrapper (before findOrCreateBank) rather than in that shared link path.

scope.why: Only the guard, its calls and focused tests.

maintainability.why: Clear single definition, but a future provider wrapper must remember to call it separately from linkBankSyncAccount, and some calls are left unformatted.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every link path still goes through linkBankSyncAccount; the guard is added beside it in each provider wrapper rather than around it.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by all five provider link functions (not inside the shared linkBankSyncAccount).
